# Dictionary

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Creates a dictionary based on the given JSON. JSON can be replaced with a dictionary from the dictionary builder.

## Syntax

~~~~text
dictionary(json: <#Dictionary#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
dictionary(json: {\)
~~~~
